page_title: NAP 1-0 CAG | Napoli v Cagliari 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.

90+5' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Alessandro Buongiorno, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Frank Anguissa (Napoli), who beats Elia Caprile with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
90+5' Noa Lang (Napoli) steps up to send the ball in.

90+3' Scott McTominay (Napoli) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Elia Caprile easily makes the save.
90+2' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Elia Caprile (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' It seemed like Matteo Politano (Napoli) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.

88' A great solo effort from Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot towards the middle of the goal. Alex Meret has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
87' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.
86' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
85' The statistic for corner kicks – 11:0. The fouls committed statistics – 14:9.
83' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Marco Palestra will be replaced by Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari).
83' Michael Folorunsho comes off the pitch to be replaced by Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari).
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.

81' Noa Lang (Napoli) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
81' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathias Olivera (Napoli) replacing Leonardo Spinazzola.
81' Substitution. Kevin De Bruyne is replaced by Noa Lang (Napoli).
80' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

80' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
79' Giuseppe Ambrosino (Napoli) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Kevin Bonacina signals a set piece.
79' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Elia Caprile, who smothers the ball.
76' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
75' Substitution. Lorenzo Lucca will be replaced by Giuseppe Ambrosino (Napoli).
74' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

71' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Adam Obert (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. Kevin Bonacina had a clear view and blows his whistle.
70' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.

69' CLOSE! Matteo Politano (Napoli) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
69' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
68' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Juan Jesus is replaced by Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli).
67' Yellow card. Juan Jesus (Napoli) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
67' Juan Jesus (Napoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
66' The game has come to an end for Sebastiano Esposito. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
65' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) replaces Matteo Prati.

64' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
62' Scott McTominay (Napoli) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
61' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) beats several players before unleashing a long-range shot on goal that flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

61' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Matteo Politano (Napoli), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
60' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) will deliver the corner kick.

60' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Elia Caprile thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. Napoli earn a corner.
59' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
58' A substitution has been made. Gabriele Zappa is replaced by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari).
56' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
56' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
56' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
55' Dangerous play by Matteo Prati (Cagliari). Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli have a free kick.
54' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
53' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) picks up an injury.
52' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.

51' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a low shot from long range towards the middle of the net, but Elia Caprile makes a comfortable save to stop the effort.
50' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
50' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman signals a throw-in for Napoli.
47' Cagliari concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
46' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) sends the corner into the box, but Elia Caprile intercepts it and averts the threat.
46' Referee Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

45' Scott McTominay (Napoli) weaves his way through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the right post is thwarted by Elia Caprile. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
43' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

41' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Matteo Prati (Cagliari) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

39' A precise low pass is received by Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
37' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
36' Cagliari hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
34' The ball possession at the moment is 71:29. The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:1.
33' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Kevin Bonacina interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
31' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
29' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Frank Anguissa (Napoli). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
29' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
27' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle and it's Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
24' Looks like Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
23' The resulting free kick from Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.

23' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Kevin Bonacina blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Napoli get a free kick.
20' Matteo Politano (Napoli) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
18' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Lorenzo Lucca, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

16' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Kevin Bonacina has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Napoli have a free kick from a promising distance.
15' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a throw-in.
14' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
14' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.

13' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Napoli.
12' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.

11' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) is going to have a crack himself.
11' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Napoli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
9' Scott McTominay (Napoli) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Kevin Bonacina who sees an offensive foul. Cagliari will take a free kick near the side line.
8' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
5' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.

4' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
3' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
2' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
1' The first half has just begun.
Cagliari will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Kevin Bonacina.
